data_source: repository Sina industry members, Tencent raw stock bars, Sina qfq factors (same factor source as repository akshare/Sina fallback); adjusted OHLC=raw/factor for every stock, no per-stock price-source splicing; CSI300 raw index bars
selection_universe: Sina declared member counts 8..80, complete membership response, >=95% download/day coverage, >=8 usable members
price_basis: all stock prices use Tencent raw divided by Sina qfq factors; downloaded Tencent qfq is retained as auxiliary evidence, not mixed into analysis
label: next-open to open h sessions later, stock-level forward returns averaged by current industry, minus CSI300 same interval; event study, no executable portfolio or costs
limitations: Current membership/size filter and exclusion of current ST stocks create selection/survivorship bias.

Candidate limit-up is inferred from standard board raw previous close, rounded to cents, qfq/raw return consistency, >20 observed sessions; not verified exchange limit prices; historical ST/IPO status unavailable.
Industry basket is equal-weight current constituents, not official Eastmoney sector index.
Money-flow history unavailable; volume ratio used instead; no sector-code cross-provider merging.
34 parameter configurations; selection on validation only; test is one exploratory holdout.
A stock may occur in multiple current industry definitions; industry observations not independent.
